recentItems.description:

La Catalina looks to make her biggest dream come true by becoming the new Reina de Reinas Champion, but first, she’ll have to end Flammer’s historic undefeated streak.

Plus, Rey Fenix defends the AAA World Cruiserweight Championship against Mini Vikingo, Jack Cartwheel, and Nathan Frazer.
